door-secret-bookcase--leaf.note: supervisor: a solid door LEAF judged by the doorway rule because the spec said opening=door; measured solid, no floating pieces, 4.0 x 1.5 x 7.5 ft, Gemini reads a bookcase

wall-secret-door--black-stone.note: supervisor: the pivoted slab leaves two narrow floor-to-head gaps (9% x 83%), which is the design; the doorway rule wants one wide opening

door-secret-bookcase-open.note: supervisor: came out as the closed bookcase barely turned (3.1 x 1.1 ft footprint against a 40 x 44 in open box); no different from the leaf, which the engine swings on its hinge

rite-cult-mask-blank.note: supervisor: lying flat it is a white dome; reads as an egg or pebble at table distance
